SELECT sa.id AS id, sa.activity_name AS activityName, sa.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.main_image AS mainImage, sa.sku_id AS skuId, sku.specs AS specs, sa.seckill_price AS seckillPrice, IFNULL(sku.price, sa.seckill_price) AS originalPrice, sa.total_stock AS totalStock, sa.available_stock AS availableStock, sa.per_limit AS perLimit, sa.start_time AS startTime, sa.end_time AS endTime FROM seckill_activity sa LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = sa.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product_sku sku ON sku.id = sa.sku_id AND sku.deleted = 0 WHERE sa.deleted = 0
AND sa.start_time > NOW()
AND sa.start_time <= NOW() AND sa.end_time >= NOW()
AND sa.end_time < NOW()
ORDER BY sa.start_time DESC

SELECT sa.id AS id, sa.activity_name AS activityName, sa.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.main_image AS mainImage, sa.sku_id AS skuId, sku.specs AS specs, sa.seckill_price AS seckillPrice, IFNULL(sku.price, sa.seckill_price) AS originalPrice, sa.total_stock AS totalStock, sa.available_stock AS availableStock, sa.per_limit AS perLimit, sa.start_time AS startTime, sa.end_time AS endTime FROM seckill_activity sa LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = sa.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product_sku sku ON sku.id = sa.sku_id AND sku.deleted = 0 WHERE sa.deleted = 0 AND sa.id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM seckill_activity WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT sa.id AS id, sa.activity_name AS activityName, sa.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.main_image AS mainImage, sa.sku_id AS skuId, sku.specs AS specs, sa.seckill_price AS seckillPrice, IFNULL(sku.price, sa.seckill_price) AS originalPrice, sa.total_stock AS totalStock, sa.available_stock AS availableStock, sa.per_limit AS perLimit, sa.start_time AS startTime, sa.end_time AS endTime, sa.total_stock - sa.available_stock AS soldQuantity, sa.created_at AS createdAt FROM seckill_activity sa LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = sa.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product_sku sku ON sku.id = sa.sku_id AND sku.deleted = 0 WHERE sa.deleted = 0 ORDER BY sa.start_time DESC
